findings.summary: The legend '123 מקורו 123 מחושב' is confusing: the reader didn't know why there were two 123s or whether a calculated number is less reliable.
The direct-costs note says there are costs on top of the fees but doesn't say how much, and the 'PF-10' tag next to it means nothing to the reader.
The one relevant documents section ('קופת גמל להשקעה · 1') was closed, and the list was mostly about other products.
The ring charts add nothing beyond the numbers next to them.
Nothing shows that the dotted underlines (and the '?' icons) can be hovered for more information, so the reader never used them.
The grey tag 'עוקב מדדי אג"ח' appears under only one track, and the reader didn't know why.
Terms are not explained: מט"ח, index tracker vs. tradable, גמיש, קיימות, הלכה יהודית. The reader couldn't use the foreign-currency exposure figure in the table.
The 'אשראי ואג"ח' track holds 5% in shares even though its name says nothing about shares.
The page says there are 16 tracks, but the reader saw only 14 because rows were cut off between screens, so some options were missed.

Information the reader wanted is missing: the worst-year drop, tax on withdrawal, whether the fee is fixed or can be negotiated, how to join and withdraw, the minimum deposit, and an example in shekels.
